name: Delicata squash
why_now: The first winter squash of the year shows up at the end of September, and delicata is the one worth buying while it is still hot outside. It is smaller, sweeter, and faster than the squash that comes in November, and unlike them, you do not have to peel it.
how_to_choose: Cream-colored with green stripes — orange in the grooves means longer cured and sweeter
Firm all over, with no soft or wet spots at either end
A dry, intact stem still attached
Small to medium; the large ones get watery
buy_this_much: 2 squash. That is two dinners' worth of roasted half-moons, or one dinner and a week of rice bowl additions.
price_note: Usually sold by the piece rather than by weight, which makes the medium ones the better buy. Early-season squash costs a little more than it will in November.

flavor_paths.name: Roasted plain
flavor_paths.description: Half-moons, oil, salt, hot oven. The version you will actually make.

flavor_paths.name: Roasted with chile
flavor_paths.description: Chile strips tossed in at the end. Sweet against smoke.

flavor_paths.name: Pickled
flavor_paths.description: Roasted hard, then hit with escabeche brine while still hot.

weekday_uses: On the sheet pan with chicken thighs
Roasted half-moons over a rice bowl
With black beans and chile strips
Cold from the fridge, with lime and salt
weekend_use: A tray roasted dark beside the fish tacos, if you want something warm.
storage: On the counter, out of the sun, for a month — it does not need the fridge and does better without it. Once cut, wrap and refrigerate, and use within four days.
one_thing_to_learn: Winter squash is sweeter than it looks, and the way to find that out is heat and space. Cut it thin, oil it well, spread it out with room between the pieces, and roast it at 425°F or higher until the edges go genuinely dark — not golden, dark. Crowd the pan and it steams into something soft and bland. It is the same lesson eggplant taught in August, on a different vegetable.
market_question: How long has this been cured? Do you have any with more orange in the stripes?
